1936 год. Прошло восемнадцать лет после:
The year 1936. Eighteen years have passed since the First Great War. In 1914 lightning struck the Monolith at 0, 0, and the first crack appeared on the tower, exactly at the level of the sixth row. Of the six Guardians at the entrance, four have fallen. Two still stand.

In the west, Romea, Carthage, Hellas, Gaul and the Island Union remember the oath of PAX. In the east, the German Reich counts its grievances, the Northern Kingdom waits for winter, and Dacia, the Horde and Scythia look at the steppe. The chroniclers of the Forum write: "Laws always lag behind weapons."

This world is taken from the lore of the PaxVanila server.

§HМир.§! 1936 год, между Первой и Второй:
§HThe world.§! 1936, between the First and Second Great Wars. Ten lore powers of the PaxVanila server hold the countries of Europe and Asia. The rest of the world is the "Far Lands".

§HFocuses.§! As on the server: Industry, Army and Economy. "Total War" and "Hegemony" are mutually exclusive. The "Legacy" focus gives a bonus of your power, the "State Faith" focus gives a bonus of its gods. The national branch follows the lore.

§HThe Monolith.§! Two last Guardians stand at the tower. When two great powers go to war, one of them falls. When both have fallen, Romea can awaken Guardian-7.

§HBlocs.§! Romea forms the PAX Union, the Northern Kingdom forms the Steppe Pact.

Пока нет войны, у всех держав дух §HМирн:
While there is no war, all powers have the §HPeaceful Sky§! spirit: army training is twice as fast, and aviation and navy train without accidents and without fuel use. It disappears with the first war.

Division templates change for free, army, navy and air experience accumulates up to 9999. Division experience from combat does not grow, training gives up to 0.9. There is almost no resistance in occupied lands.

Aircraft attrition is reduced (air combat damage is 0.35 of vanilla), and aviation does not hit supply or railways. Advice from Family: from the start train one division at 50 combat width, it gains experience quickly.
